historical_supplement.integration: Read current and supplement; kept current world-specific selection and canonical worldClockConfiguration. Added only necessary guards in existing phone-database module; no old tree replacement.

before.note: Original current candidate with initial16 tests: actual invalid decodes/write proposals and storage boundary rejections were exercised. One origin regression was added after the first baseline run.

behavior: Persisted binding requires X_WORLD_CLOCKS, actual record ID and integer origin; invalid binding is never repaired by choosing another row.
Clock ownership must match current phone world and must not carry explicit unknown/unset/cleared/error value state.
Required clock position values must be integers and confirmed if state metadata is present; old rows without state metadata remain compatible.
A foreign row occupying world-clock:<world> blocks initialization; global runtime selector belonging to another world remains ignored.
Same guard is used by encode, decode and native profile discovery; canonical calendar units/rules are retained.

validation_boundary.unit: Actual phone codec, Runtime, WorldClock and worldClockConfiguration modules run in Node.
validation_boundary.isolated_simulation: Actual createPhoneDatabaseStorage load/save functions; database read/persistence callback is a controlled substitute. Both invalid load/save perform zero commit calls and preserve state.

next_step: Root integrates shared settings UI, rebuilds runtime/phone output, runs integrated gate, then freezes/persists actual same-point source and evidence.
